text:
[LDIA.4.2] Everything in the language that no capability governs is
available to every program, under every setting. This includes the full
expression grammar, pattern matching (including `no`, `within`,
`then`/`latest`), schema declarations (including `tolerance`), `let`
bindings, rule-header `cooldown`, intra-tier
`emit`, `log`, `cached(...)` reads, adapter entity matching and string
interpolation.
